issue.title: The group row at the bottom of property cards
issue.description: Day, week, and quarter cards and grouped record walk rails show a quiet group row (`« Q3 · W27 … week 8 of 14 ▮▮■▯ … 2027-Q1 · W01 »`) from the same resolver behind `[N` / `]N`; legacy dailies get a derived step row; every missing stop reads dashed `+` (creatable) or dotted and faint (ghost) across rail items, chips, and arms; the album card says `· walks by Section`; and a preview matrix plus the existing e2e suites prove it on athena.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Load-sensitive Ledger/Nav timing tests flake only under the parallel full npm test — this phase saw test-ledger-tools-event-link-times.cjs:1069 (28.5/33.6 ms vs 25), test-ledger-tools-frees-marks.cjs:481 (73 ms vs 25), test-navigation-dependencies-stage-performance.cjs:64 (cubic-growth ratio), test-command-mode-sheet-sequence-dom.cjs:173 (30 s timeout), and a minute-rollover race in test-ledger-tools-gcal-events.cjs:761 (nowMinutes 761 vs 762); every file passes in isolation. Same class as the follow-up already recorded on bob-cli-oj.1; consider moving wall-time asserts to the serial perf lane and pinning the gcal test clock.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-plugins docs/reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md is over the 6000-word reference budget (6247) on origin/master 7b44b29, failing npm run docs:check identically on the clean base (likely since the bob-cli-om.3 prose-field docs); no open bead tracks it. The other docs:check error (vault-format.md 6037/6000) is tracked by bob-cli-oc.

row-kit landed in bob-plugins Ledger Tools 1.150.0 (on origin/master 7b44b29; commit via this turn's finalizer). New 240l propertyCardBuildGroupRow (arms with state/wrap/glyphs/narrow labels, centre position with sr label + wide/narrow, tick track or >21 bar+thumb), exported via new 374d; 240g propertyCardBuildRail takes per-item/chip state + ghostReason + tooltip (unresolved => creatable; exists DOM byte-identical, pinned by a serialization test), optional spec.group row between step row and children, group-only rails skip the empty step row, return gains group. CSS in its own 'Property-card group row (bob-cli-oj group-rail)' block right after the kit block: dashed+ creatable, dotted faint ghost, no unresolved underline on stated items, group grid/type/ticks/bar, narrow below 28rem for bob-property-card and record-walk containers, forced-colors (CanvasText/GrayText/Highlight), reduced motion. Verified: new scripts/test-ledger-tools-property-card-group-row.cjs 13/13 (registered in test:unit); identity + intention title-block tests unchanged and green; npm run build:check green; full npm test 8191/8197 with only load/timing flakes that pass in isolation (recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); docs:check fails only on base budget errors (nav-hotkeys reference 6247/6000, vault-format 6037/6000 = bob-cli-oc), identical on the clean base. Throwaway Obsidian render (light/dark x 900/375 + forced-colors) checked: narrow collapses to '« 2025-Q4 · 1/13 · Q2 »', measured text/border contrast >= 5.15:1 for every state after pulling muted 15% and faint 45% toward --text-normal. bob plugins sync deployed 1.150.0; bob plugins list --no-pull shows synced.
